content.short: Creating the infrastructure for Game & Metaverse projects to integrate Smart Contracts and NFTs.
content.description: Blockchain gaming and Metaverse have been two hot topics in the crypto space recently. Cardano has the potential to take the lead in that sector but for that it needs a great ecosystem of tools and dApps for games to launch and grow. Including a reliable Marketplace and DEX. What could really make the difference is in-game, in-universe integration. Imagine transacting your NFT in-game, without having to go to a marketplace.
